sentences.englishText: I was stil ten years old and I was in the village.
I went to our grandmother's with my mother to clean her house.
sentences.turkishText: Annemle birlikte evini temizlemek için anneannemlere gitmiştik.

sentences.englishText: My aunt and his son Mustafa was there, too.
sentences.turkishText: Teyzem ve oğlu Mustafa da oradaydı.

sentences.englishText: While we were cleaning the house, Mustafa took my grandmother's glasses and ran away.
sentences.turkishText: Biz evi temizlerken, Mustafa anneannemin gözlüğünü alıp kaçtı.

sentences.englishText: Grandmother told me to took back the glasses back so that he didn't break it.
sentences.turkishText: Anneannem o gözlüğü kırmasın diye gözlüğü geri getirmemi söyledi.

sentences.englishText: There was a concrete jungle in front of the window and were stones below the window.
sentences.turkishText: Pencerenin önünde beton yığını ve aşağı tarafında taşlar vardı.

sentences.englishText: Mustafa climbed the concrete jungle, laid down the flapper and started to fall down.
sentences.turkishText: Mustafa beton yığınına tırmandı, sinekliğe yaslandı ve düşmeye başladı.

sentences.englishText: He hold the window and I suddenly ran and caught his hands and pulled him up.
sentences.turkishText: Pencereye tutundu ve ben aniden koştum ve ellerini tuttum ve onu yukarıya çektim.
